name: The Dalaran Digest
summary: The librarian asks you to bring magical works for the collection. Each book adds knowledge to the library.

sections.title: The Collection
sections.body: The librarian welcomes magical works that may benefit the library. You bring a book to join the collection, helping its knowledge grow.

faq.answer: The librarian asks you to bring magical works that may benefit the collection.

faq.q: Where do I bring the book?
faq.answer: Bring the book to the librarian who asked you to add it to the collection.

faq.q: Why is the librarian collecting magical works?
faq.answer: Your contribution brings more knowledge to the collection.
